title: Bundled Player Rebalance
doc: Supplies the verified Player Rebalance SQL and locale payload under BepInEx/config/ckf.hardmode.rebalances/player to the native mod loader. Independent of ModelRules. Disable the separate Player Rebalance Workshop item before using this slice. Regenerate the payload after authoring changes; see docs/bundled-rebalances.md.
uiDoc: Applies the bundled Player Rebalance package. Disable the separate Player Rebalance Workshop mod before enabling this switch.

fields.label: Enable Bundled Player Rebalance
fields.doc: BundledRebalances.Init checks this gate before reading the package and AfterList supplies its active native mod entry. Independent of ModelRules.
fields.uiDoc: Enable the bundled player talent, equipment and character adjustments.
